text: Who is the toughest batter of this generation to bowl to? There is only one answer AB Dibler's and I'll prove it with two innings. January 2015 Johannesburg AB walks out against West Indies
50/16 balls and 100/31 balls. Both still ODI world records. He finishes on 149 of Jers 44 balls.
Now December, the same year, Delhi, South Africa are fighting to sever tests. AB faces 297 balls for 43 runs.

Same man, same year, the fastest hundred in ODI SP and one of the most stubborn test innings you will ever see. That's the problem for ballers. You never knew which AB was walking out. Ball full, he drives you. Ball short, he pulls you. Ball wide, he walks across and scoops you over fine legs. Most bettors can either attack you or outlast you. AB could do both.
That's why is the toughest batter of these generation agree or disagree tell me in the comments and follow for more stories like this.
